paper_title: New Exclusion Limits for the Search of Scalar and Pseudoscalar Axion-Like Particles from "Light Shining Through a Wall"
notes: OSQAR LSW (light-shining-through-wall) experiment. Pseudoscalar ALP limit g_agamma < 3.5e-8 GeV^-1 and scalar ALP limit < 3.2e-8 GeV^-1 for m_A < 2e-4 eV at 95% CL. Data extracted from text; the exclusion plot (Fig. 6) shows a flat limit up to ~2e-4 eV then rising. Reported here the pseudoscalar limit. The scalar limit (3.2e-8) is a separate curve.
